# Curavex

> Clinical treatment-response regression and MLOps governance platform.
> Author: Krish Ujeniya (@krishujeniya)
> Live Site: https://curavex.pages.dev/
> API Docs: https://api-curavex.workers.dev/docs
> Source Repository: https://github.com/krishujeniya/curavex
> Extended Context: https://curavex.pages.dev/llms-full.txt

## Overview
Curavex is a clinical MLOps web platform built by Krish Ujeniya (krishujeniya) for predicting treatment-response improvement scores, scoring patient cohorts from CSV, governing regression models, and monitoring statistical feature drift.

## Author & Ecosystem
- Author: Krish Ujeniya (https://github.com/krishujeniya)
- Portfolio: https://krishujeniya.pages.dev/
- Related Projects by krishujeniya: AGYOS, AmberClaw, Hadron, WaferPulse, Somnostasis, Hajree, Scanlark, TraceMigo

## Core Capabilities
- Single-patient treatment response scoring (`/api/v1/predict`) with 95% confidence intervals and feature attributions
- Batch cohort CSV scoring (`/api/v1/predict/upload-csv`)
- Model registry, retraining, and production promotion (`/api/v1/models`)
- Kolmogorov-Smirnov and PSI drift monitoring and latency percentiles (`/api/v1/monitoring/*`)
